verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a first-party integrations catalog of 750+ platform integrations (docs-50, docs-84). The only named tool from this stack in the evidence is Sentry, and that is an SRE Agent connector for retrieving logs rather than alert ingestion (docs-68). The Events API's ability to ingest events from observability platforms is a developer building block and earns no credit as a first-party integration. missing for 10: evidence of first-party Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus and CloudWatch integrations, documented setup guides for each named tool, a Sentry alert-ingestion integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
